landing_page.grid: Tetris grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) for features. Asymmetrical layouts.
landing_page.hero: Full height or max-h-[80vh] with bg-black/40 gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Big Outfit headings.
landing_page.visuals: Organic shapes, wide landscape photography, generous negative space.

dashboard.grid: Control Room grid. Sidebar + Main content area. Main area uses grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4.
dashboard.map_section: Dominant element. col-span-1 lg:col-span-3 row-span-2. h-[600px] or flex-1. Needs solid borders.
dashboard.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid border (border-border). No default shadow. Hover gets -translate-y-1 and shadow-md.
dashboard.kpi_tiles: col-span-1. Clean, large data values (text-3xl font-light). Subtle icon in top right.

components.alerts: Use destructive (terracotta) for high severity (fires, deforestation), chart_3 (ochre) for medium severity (illegal agriculture).
components.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized. Input fields have 1px solid border, pale sage focus ring (ring-primary/50).
components.navigation: Dashboard: Sidebar layout with icons. Landing: Sticky Crystal Glass header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70).

image_urls.description: Lush green tropical forest aerial view for landing page hero background
Drone flying over a green forest for the drone missions landing or dashboard card
Forest rangers/firefighters near a utility vehicle for field observations module
Winding river through mangrove/forest for GEE/Satellite tracking feature section

accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background or foreground on hover. Ensure contrast.
accessibility_and_interactions.focus_rings: Standardize focus-visible with ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background.
accessibility_and_interactions.data_testid: ALL buttons, links, form inputs, map layers, and alert cards MUST include role-based data-testid (e.g., 'login-submit-button', 'alert-resolve-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a full-stack hybrid app: A Landing page (marketing style, generous padding, large text) and a Dashboard (dense, functional, sidebar navigation).
Use Shadcn UI. Apply the provided HSL color variables exactly to globals.css.
Import Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts.
Dashboard should heavily feature react-leaflet for the map. The map should be prominent (col-span-3 in a 4-col grid).
Mock the GEE data (NDVI, NBR) as raster overlays on the map or as separate data cards.
Implement the Alert workflow (Detected -> Verification -> Confirmed -> Resolved). Use Terracotta (#d35400) for high alerts.
Ensure all dashboard cards are cardless/flat (no shadow, 1px border) with hover lifts.
Implement Role-Based Access Control UI structures (Admin, Analyst, Agent, Pilot).
